evidence: Static reading passes every item the workbook row (Quality Checks A23:D23) and skill check 22 (quality-checks.md:96-98) name. All paths below are under .qc-cache/hireops-live-desk-2026-10-02-r2/task. (1) Pinned bases: tests/Dockerfile:1 'FROM node:22-bookworm-slim AS node-runtime', :2 'FROM python:3.12-slim'. (2) Judge CLI and Playwright MCP pinned: tests/Dockerfile:17 '@anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281', :19 '@playwright/mcp@0.0.79'; this matches task.toml:31 REWARDKIT_JUDGE = "claude-code". (3) Pinned browser: tests/Dockerfile:34-38 installs chromium through the Playwright bundled inside the pinned @playwright/mcp and symlinks it to /usr/local/bin/chromium, which is the exact path every judge.toml passes ('--executable-path=/usr/local/bin/chromium', command 'playwright-mcp') in all five dimensions. An empty find result would make 'ln -sf ""' fail the build rather than ship a broken image. (4) Pinned RewardKit: tests/Dockerfile:31 'pip3 install --no-cache-dir harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7'. (5) python3 for the restart server: the python:3.12-slim base provides /usr/local/bin/python3, the path tests/scored/functional/judge.toml uses for restart_mcp.py; the COPY of node's /usr/local at tests/Dockerfile:4 adds node and does not remove python. (6) App runtime: tests/Dockerfile:20-21 'express@5.1.0', 'better-sqlite3@12.4.1' with NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules (:9), identical to environment/Dockerfile:10-11 and :3 and to solution/app/package.json dependencies; the golden's only non-builtin requires are express (src/index.js:22) and better-sqlite3 (src/db.js:10); test.sh:106 injects the same NODE_PATH. (7) Launch tools: tests/Dockerfile:13 installs util-linux (setpriv, setsid used at test.sh:99-111) and procps. (8) tests/Dockerfile:43-44 copies /tests and makes test.sh executable; .dockerignore excludes only Dockerfile, .dockerignore, __pycache__. (9) tests/Dockerfile, tests/test.sh, tests/.dockerignore, tests/tools/*, tests/scoring.toml and environment/Dockerfile are byte-identical to the frozen template (tests/Dockerfile sha256 72998ab8... on both sides), so no template-controlled setting drifted. Runtime evidence, partial: a local image hireops-verifier:20261002-permission-repair exists whose build history reproduces every RUN/COPY/ENV line of this Dockerfile, so the pinned versions resolved and the image built (amd64, Python 3.12.14, created 2026-10-01T19:03Z). The raw-evidence index (all 10 artifact hashes and all 14 source hashes verified by me) records scripted golden runs in that image: live-desk.cjs:5 loads Playwright from the image's @playwright/mcp and :62 launches /usr/local/bin/chromium; results/live-desk.json shows 11 of 11 scripted observations passed with no page errors; results/server.log shows '[hireops] listening on 3000' twice (start and restart). That confirms the browser and the app runtime work in the image. Why risk stays true: no configured grading run exists for this candidate. Nothing shows claude-code 2.1.281, rewardkit 0.1.7 and playwright-mcp actually starting and returning a verdict in this image through OpenRouter; the index itself says full configured grading is absent. qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md requires a hash-bound full verifier launch/grading record before local clearance, so the 'grade' half is unmeasured. I did not check whether the image's /tests layer matches the frozen tests bytes (that needs a container). Latent robustness points, P3, all template-controlled and not task defects: bases are tag-pinned, not digest-pinned (python:3.12-slim currently resolves to Debian trixie while node comes from bookworm; the existing build works); apt packages and Playwright --with-deps are unpinned, which the workbook's check-dockerfiles.py treats as a NOTE; tests/Dockerfile:41 patches rewardkit's Codex flags with an assert tied to python3.12 and rewardkit 0.1.7, which would fail the build loudly, not silently, if either moved. Counterexample search: a broken app cannot gain from the image contents; a conforming alternative app that uses only express and better-sqlite3 from NODE_PATH, as the agent image provides, starts identically in the verifier image. An app that npm-installs extra packages into /app/node_modules is copied with them by test.sh:92, so it is not penalised by the image.
